 Cameron University encourages current and prospective college students to complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid now to get the bests consideration for financial aid for the 2027-2028 academic year.
 Early submission of a FAFSA ensures access to the maximum amount of grants, work-study funds and low-interest student loans that can help reduce out-of-pocket costs for those seeking a college education.
